content: The American Association of Homes and Services for the Aging (AAHSA) is an organization that supports housing and services for the elderly. The American Association of Medical Colleges (AAMC) represents medical schools and teaching hospitals in the United States. The American Association of Physicians and Surgeons (AAPS) is a professional organization advocating for private medical practice. An autologous bone marrow transplant (ABMT) involves using a patient’s own bone marrow for transplantation after intensive therapy. The American Cancer Society (ACS) is a nationwide organization dedicated to cancer research, education, and advocacy. The Administration for Children and Families (ACF) is a division of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services that focuses on child welfare and family support. The American Dietetic Association (ADA) is a professional organization for dietitians and nutritionists. The American Dental Association (ADA) is the leading professional association for dentists in the United States. The American Diabetes Association (ADA) is a nonprofit organization focused on diabetes research, education, and advocacy. The Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) is a U.S. law that prohibits discrimination against individuals with disabilities. Activities of daily living (ADL) refer to basic self-care tasks such as eating, bathing, and dressing. An adverse drug reaction (ADR) is an unintended and harmful response to a medication. The ADMIRAL trial studied the use of abciximab before angioplasty and stenting in patients with myocardial infarction, assessing both acute and long-term outcomes. Aid to Families with Dependent Children (AFDC) was a federal assistance program providing financial support to low-income families. The African Medical Association (AFMA) is a professional organization representing healthcare professionals across Africa. The American Hospital Association (AHA) is a national organization representing hospitals and healthcare networks. The American Heart Association (AHA) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to cardiovascular health and stroke prevention. The American Health Care Association (AHCA) represents long-term and post-acute care providers. An Area Health Education Center (AHEC) is a program designed to improve healthcare access in underserved areas by training healthcare professionals. America’s Health Insurance Plans (AHIP) is a trade association representing the health insurance industry. The Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ) is a U.S. government agency focused on improving healthcare quality and safety. The African Malaria Network Trust (AMANET) is an organization dedicated to malaria research and control in Africa. The American Medical Group Association (AMGA) represents medical groups and integrated healthcare systems. The American Nurses Association (ANA) is a professional organization for registered nurses in the United States. The American Optometric Association (AOA) represents optometrists and promotes eye health. The American Osteopathic Association (AOA) represents osteopathic physicians and promotes osteopathic medicine. The Administrative Procedures Act (APA) governs the process by which federal agencies develop and issue regulations. The American Psychiatric Association (APA) is a professional organization for psychiatrists. The American Pharmaceutical Association (APA) is a professional organization for pharmacists. Ambulatory payment classification (APC) is a system used by Medicare to determine payment for outpatient services. All Patient Diagnosis Related Groups (APDRG) is a classification system used to group patients with similar clinical conditions for billing purposes. The American Public Health Association (APHA) is a professional organization for public health professionals. The American Protestant Hospital Association (APHA) represents Protestant-affiliated hospitals. The American Society of Anesthesiology (ASA) is a professional organization for anesthesiologists. An Ambulatory Surgery Center (ASC) is a facility where surgeries that do not require hospital admission are performed. An Administrative Service Organization (ASO) provides administrative services for health plans or employers. The Association of State and Territorial Health Officials (ASTHO) represents public health agencies in the United States. Average wholesale price (AWP) is a benchmark used in the pharmaceutical industry to determine drug pricing.
